thread:
alex: Quick update on Primus-9B int4 bring-up — ran 48h of traffic-sim slices last night, results below.

katie: nice, TL;DR? :eyes:

alex: TL;DR: int4 is ~2.6x cheaper than int8 on our infra, p50 generation latency +12ms, p99 +40ms, and a small quality hit on long-form QA (~-2.8% QA F1 on our GTN long-answer slice).

liam: where are those numbers from? which slice and batch config?
alex: slice = GTN_LF_v2 (long-form answers, avg 420 tokens). batch=dynamic 4, kvcache warm, kernel set v2. Per-token cost calc based on GPU-seconds + infra overhead.

maria: can you paste the scorecard snapshot? I want the product-facing talk track for tomorrow.
alex: pasted below. short table: 
- Primus-9B int8: cost index 1.0, p50 110ms, p99 420ms, QA F1 78.6
- Primus-9B int4: cost index 0.38, p50 122ms, p99 460ms, QA F1 75.8
- Baseline 13B (Helios-13B): cost index 1.9, p50 140ms, p99 520ms, QA F1 80.4

katie: so int4 is attractive on price but a ~2.8pt F1 drop vs int8 on long answers. product will ask how visible that is in user metrics. any hallucination delta?

alex: hallucination rate (GTN hallucination rubric) up ~1.4pp. Most regressions are phrasing/verbosity, not factual inversions, but shows up as lower score on our QA pass-blacklist.

liam: do we have a cheap routing plan? mixed fleet maybe: Primus-int4 for NRT low-value traffic, fallback 13B for high-value.
maria: product prefers single-model SLA but open to hybrid if ops is straightforward. Also want to know the marginal dollars saved per 10k sessions.
alex: quick econ math: int4 saves ~$0.62 per 1k tokens vs int8 in our region. For GTN baseline traffic (avg 1.6M tokens/day), that's ~ $1k/day savings. Rough numbers, happy to formalize.

katie: ops checklist? monitoring, rollouts, fallback triggers?

liam: minimal is: 1) canary 5% traffic, 2) realtime QA signal (GTN metrics) monitored, 3) latency SLO guardrail (p99 < 480ms), 4) automatic fallback to int8/13B on regression.
maria: can you draft a one-paragraph recommendation for PMs including the risk and rollback plan?
alex: sure — "Recommend Primus-9B int4 as primary for non-critical GTN traffic to capture ~62% unit-cost reduction vs int8. Holdback 10-20% of high-value queries to Helios-13B until 2 weeks of live signal shows no QA drift >1.0pt and hallucination delta <1pp. Implement p99 latency and GTN-F1 monitors with auto-fallback to int8/13B if thresholds breached. Rollout via 5% -> 20% -> 50% steps with daily scorecard checks."

katie: can we add an experiment to test prefix-cache Hermetic priming to recover some of the F1 drop?

alex: already tried short priming templates — recovered ~0.6pt F1 on long answers, cost-neutral. Will include in rapid follow-up.

ops-bot: deploy check: canary config pushed to staging, ci-pipeline green. Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/primus-int4-canary

maria: great. next actions: alex to write PM blurb + econ spreadsheet, liam to queue canary ramp, katie to own GTN dashboards. I’ll present this at tomorrow GTN sync.

liam: queued. tagging @katie for dashboard access perms.
katie: thanks — will add the GTN-F1 and hallucination delta panels. :ok_hand: 

alex: done for now, will DM the spreadsheet. thanks team!
